standouts.head: Confirmed double bottom

standouts.learn: Two lows at the same level with a peak between; a close above the peak confirms it.

standouts.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
standouts.text: On the weekly chart: five clean waves up from Jul 10, 2023 to Nov 11, 2024 (+54%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−18% to −24%), on lighter volume, with the Jun 5, 2023 high and the 38.2% retracement of the Nov 11, 2024–Nov 3, 2025 drop in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−32%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+4.5%) says wave 3 is under way.
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.

standouts.head: Retesting its breakout level
standouts.text: It broke out above the July high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
standouts.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

standouts.head: Downtrend broken: over its last swing high
standouts.text: The swings had been falling, but price has closed over the last swing high (Sep 14): the run of lower highs is broken.
standouts.learn: When price closes over the last swing high, the run of lower highs ends.

standouts.head: MACD positive
standouts.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram falling.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; crossing above its signal line means momentum is turning up.

against.head: An outside reversal down
against.text: On Oct 23 it traded above the prior high and below the prior low, then closed near its bottom: a key reversal.
against.learn: A session that trades beyond both ends of the day before and closes at an extreme.

against.head: Distribution

against.learn: Up days on heavy volume mean institutions are buying; heavy down days (distribution) mean they are selling.

against.head: Stochastic leaving overbought
against.text: The stochastic fell back below 80 (to 80) on Oct 23: buying pressure easing.
against.learn: Where the close sits in the recent range, 0-100; leaving 20 or 80 marks a turn.

EIG.change: No trade until a daily close above +3%; once in, a daily close below +0.5%, under the 52-week high, proves it wrong. The case against, that there is an outside reversal down, fails on the close that starts the buy.

against.head: Five waves up look complete
against.text: Five clean waves up from Apr 2 to Oct 22 (+65%), and the fifth wave's high came on weaker momentum than the third's (RSI 71 against 78 on Aug 27). A finished five is usually followed by a pullback, often to the 0.382–0.618 of the advance (−15% to −24%): the buy is the next wave 2, not this high.
against.learn: A fifth wave that makes a new high on weaker momentum than the third often ends the advance; the next buy is the pullback after it, not the high.

against.head: Uptrend structure broken, then reclaimed
against.text: On Sep 30 it closed under the Sep 18 higher low, ending the run of higher lows, and it has closed back over that low since; the larger swings (4 ATR) are intact.
against.learn: An uptrend steps up in higher highs and higher lows; a lower high is the first warning, and a close under the last higher low breaks it.

against.head: A descending triangle

against.head: A thin rise

standouts.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 27 to Jul 29 (+34%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−2.3% to −7.2%), in three waves, with the Nov 25, 2025 high and the 61.8% retracement of the Mar 27–Jul 29 rise in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−14%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+16%) says wave 3 is under way.
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.

material.head: Weekly chart: declining
material.text: On the weekly chart price is below a falling 30-week average: the declining stage.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the May high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.

material.head: Support −7.1% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −7.1% below (1.9 ATR), where 7 levels of 5 kinds meet: the average price paid since the Sep 15 low, the most-traded price of six months and the 50-day average.

material.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: On the weekly chart: five clean waves up from Oct 21, 2024 to Jan 12 (+214%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−6.9% to −25%), with the Oct 9, 2023 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−49%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+61%) says wave 3 is under way.

fear.label: Fear day: Fri Oct 23
fear.text: Fri Oct 23: SPY and EYE both closed red, the kind of day the desk's fear-day rule buys.

plan.sentence: Buy the reaction on a pullback to between −13% and −21% from the Oct 23 close: a daily close up inside the zone. Take a fifth off at +7.5%; hold the rest for +86%, for at most 40 sessions. Out on a daily close below −28%.
plan.why_zone: the 0.618–0.786 retracement of the Dec 19, 2025–May 7 advance and the Feb 13 low
plan.why_t1: the May 19 low and the average price paid since the Oct 1 low

EZPW.gist: A stock; the buy is lower, at support (the 0.618–0.786 retracement of the Dec 19, 2025–May 7 advance and the Feb 13 low); it has pulled back to a level where buyers usually return.

standouts.head: Weekly: wave 4 in its buy zone
standouts.text: On the weekly chart: waves 1 to 3 up from Aug 4, 2025 to May 4 (+166%; wave 3 is 3.8 times wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (+1.9% to −6.6%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the Aug 10 low in the same place. The count is wrong on a daily close under the wave-1 high (−32%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
standouts.learn: After waves 1 to 3 up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.382 and 0.5 retracement of wave 3, above the top of wave 1. A daily close up inside the zone is the buy; a close under the wave-1 high ends the count.

standouts.head: Sitting on stacked support
standouts.text: Price sits on the Jun 10 low, the 50-week average and the Jul 30 low, where 3 levels of 2 kinds meet.
standouts.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

standouts.head: In an 8-week base
standouts.text: It has moved sideways for 8 weeks in a range 23% deep after a +29% advance.
standouts.learn: A sideways range after a move, where the stock rests before its next leg.

against.head: Resistance +1.9% above
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +1.9% above (0.4 ATR), where 7 levels of 4 kinds meet: the Oct 1 low, the 200-day average and the average price paid since the Oct 16 high: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
against.learn: A price area where sellers stepped in before.

against.head: Lost its 50-day average
against.text: It closed below its 50-day average in the last three sessions.
against.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

against.head: Below its averages
against.text: Price has slipped below both its 50-day and 200-day averages.
against.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

EZPW.take: EZPW: it is below its averages. Resistance +1.9% overhead leaves too little room from here. The better price is lower, at the 0.618–0.786 retracement of the Dec 19, 2025–May 7 advance and the Feb 13 low. It is in its wave-4 buy zone on the weekly chart, and it is in an 8-week base. Against it, it lost its 50-day average. The desk is against buying it here; only the lower price makes it worth owning.
EZPW.change: A daily close below −28%, under the 0.886 retracement of wave 1, proves it wrong. The case against, that it lost its 50-day average, fails on a daily close above +10%, the 50-day average.
